GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (22 May 46) GB/CIS
(SCAPIN - 977)
APO 500
22 May 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of FUJIWARA, Ginjiro and IKEDA, Seihin.
1. The following named persons have been released from house arrest:
FUJIWARA, Ginjiro
IKEDA, Seihin
2. It is directed that the names of these individuals be unconditionally deleted from the apprehension list.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
